items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Cloud Software Security (CSS) Summer Internship, Undergraduate Intern

 

At Fernhaven, we are always looking for the next generation of innovative thinkers to drive our business forward. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, innovate and partner with professionals across the globe while gaining knowledge about our business. At Fernhaven, you are encouraged to be yourself, you will find a culture where differences are celebrated, and diverse ideas are heard and respected. Our mission is to enable the future generation of professionals to create strong networks, achieve critical experiences, and develop core skills that position you for career success. 

 

Join us as a Cloud Software Security Intern on our Commercial Sales team in Round Rock, Texas to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact. 

 

What you’ll achieve 

Fernhaven is seeking summer interns. This internship is geared towards individuals who have an interest in sales, along with aspirations to advance to leadership or outside sales positions. Our Interns will participate in a customer outreach campaign promoting end user solutions. You will be trained and equipped with the latest resources to represent Fernhaven in the marketplace. Each intern will be aligned to multiple Fernhaven team members for mentoring, guidance and understanding of the #SimplyTheBest culture promoted within the organization.
items.ExternalResponsibilitiesStr:
You will: 

  • Have regular mentoring and coaching from tenured Fernhaven team members 

  • Attend multiple Global Intern events – (Executive Meet & Greets, Career & Personal Branding Guidance, General Networking & Just for Fun Events) 

  • Collaborate with fellow interns, building new friendships and sharing best practices 

  • Foster a Network of mentors and contacts within Fernhaven 

  • Build and develop a final presentation to be shared with executives
items.ExternalQualificationsStr:
Take the first step towards your dream career 

Every Fernhaven team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: 

Essential Requirements  

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree 
  • Enjoy interacting with others and see yourself as a promoter 
  • Energized by innovation and comfortable thinking outside of the box 
  • Work well in team environments 
  • Open to coaching, feedback and willingness to implement 

 

Compensation 

Fernhaven is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range for this position is: $21.03 - $28.92/ per hour.

Benefits and Perks of working at Fernhaven

Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Fernhaven team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com 

Who we are

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Fernhaven is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.
